answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using satellite Doppler attestation. As low-Earth-orbit transmitters pass their orbital zenith, each agent must sign time-synchronized frequency shifts to prove its physical coordinates. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of provisioning discrete radio hardware across dispersed geographic locations, from an isolated mesa to areas with ferrous structures. However, ionospheric drift can perturb signal propagation and falsely reject honest nodes.
